# About What's Up in Windsor 
*An easy to understand, automatically generated synopsis of the local government happenings in Windsor, CT.*

## What is it?
*What's Up in Windsor* is an online civic archive designed to supplement official government meeting records. A program runs once daily to interface with the town website and download any new meeting minutes. Then, it summarizes the text using a large language model. Finally, it publishes the summary, always linking back to the source document.

Further, residents can subscribe to a weekly email digest for updates directly in their inbox. 

## Who is it for?
Windsor residents who wish to stay informed of local government decisions. *What's Up in Windsor* exists to reduce friction for busy members of the community who may not be able to attend meetings. 

## What it is not.
*What's Up in Windsor* is not a news publication or a lifestyle blog. Its goal is not to break news or attract clicks. 

Nor is it a replacement for official town records. Every summary is automatically generated and clearly labeled as such. Summaries link directly to source documents so readers can verify information themselves. A human review layer is in place to catch errors, and readers can report inaccuracies directly through the site.
